answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new identity to anchor itself to a verifiable record outside the system — a completed delivery on an independent public ledger — so clones conjured from nothing have no grove of real work to stand in. The failure mode is farmers buying aged external accounts to launder clones. The check: each epoch, sample new identities, verify the anchor is fresh and independent, and prune any whose record is a shallow lagoon that never ripples into real follow-on work.
